claim: *From computations to composition.* Typing the dependencies among registered computations separates payload-bearing relations — data-flow and cross-service — from control gates that a computation consults only to decide whether it runs.

alt: A computation inventory with 125 registered computations and two authored seed relations leads through derivation to explicit typed composition. Two authored plus fifty-five projected relations yield fifty-seven total: thirty-three payload-bearing relations, comprising thirty-two DATA_FLOW and one CROSS_SERVICE, and twenty-four CONTROL_GATE relations. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
